findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_a2a_card, read_binder, preflight_endpoint, check_before_you_pay, buy_signed_record, buy_observation, buy_memory_anchor · Private data: check_a2a_card, check_purchase, read_binder, look_at_door, check_before_you_pay, verify_artifact, check_order, buy_simple, buy_signed_record, buy_human_task, buy_observation, buy_mandate, buy_memory_anchor, buy_small_pleasure · Public sink: check_a2a_card, check_conformance, buy_human_task · Destructive: buy_signed_record, buy_human_task, buy_observation, buy_mandate, buy_memory_anchor, buy_small_pleasure.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_a2a_card, read_binder, preflight_endpoint, check_before_you_pay, buy_signed_record, buy_observation, buy_memory_anchor · Private data: check_a2a_card, check_purchase, read_binder, look_at_door, check_before_you_pay, verify_artifact, check_order, buy_simple, buy_signed_record, buy_human_task, buy_observation, buy_mandate, buy_memory_anchor, buy_small_pleasure · Public sink: check_a2a_card, check_conformance, buy_human_task · Destructive: buy_signed_record, buy_human_task, buy_observation, buy_mandate, buy_memory_anchor, buy_small_pleasure

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
